llm.summary: This is a markdown-only creative writing skill for murder-mystery scripts, with no evidence of code execution, data access, persistence, or credential use.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently support the stated purpose: writing and improving Chinese murder-mystery game scripts with references for worldbuilding, characters, clues, timelines, mechanics, and output format.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger metadata includes some broad creative-writing terms and the instructions are Chinese-only, which may affect routing or usability, but this is a scope/quality issue rather than a security concern because the skill has no high-impact authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package consists of SKILL.md plus markdown reference and asset files; metadata reports no API key requirement, no executable scripts, and clean static/VirusTotal results.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No artifact requests filesystem, network, shell, browser, credential, account, or local profile access; the only external contact detail is a submission email/WeChat listed as publishing guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, auto-run behavior, credential/session handling, or mutation authority was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Safe to install for Chinese-language murder-mystery writing help. Users should be aware it may activate on some generic creative-writing prompts and may need manual language guidance if they want responses outside Chinese.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger terms are real in the frontmatter and could cause overactivation for generic writing requests, but they do not grant sensitive access or create hidden behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is written entirely in Chinese; this may be a language-fit and accessibility limitation, but it is consistent with the artifact's target content and not a security issue.
